parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace where the application resides. Cross-namespace applications are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用所在命名空间ID，目前不支持跨命名空间的应用
parameters.name: namespace_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the routing rule
parameters.help_zh: 路由规则名称
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The SLB instance ID used by the routing rule.

Server Load Balancer (SLB) includes CLB and ALB instances
parameters.help_zh:
路由规则所使用的SLB实例ID。

负载均衡SLB包括CLB实例和ALB实例
parameters.name: slb_id

parameters.help_en: The listening port of the SLB instance. The port must not be occupied
parameters.help_zh: SLB监听端口，该端口不能被占用
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the CLB certificate. Valid values:

If LoadBalanceType is set to clb, use this field to configure the certificate for the HTTPS listener.

For more information about how to use SSL certificate IDs in CLB, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90792.html
parameters.help_zh:
CLB证书ID。取值说明如下：

LoadBalanceType为clb时，使用该字段来配置HTTPS监听证书。

CLB使用SSL证书ID的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90792.html
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the ALB certificates. Valid values:

If LoadBalanceType is set to alb, use this field to configure multiple certificates for the HTTPS listener. Separate multiple certificate IDs with commas (,).

You must obtain the SSL certificate IDs used by ALB from the Certificate Management Service. For example, if you configure `756***-cn-hangzhou`, `756***` is the certificate ID obtained from the product page, and `-cn-hangzhou` is a fixed suffix. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209076.html
parameters.help_zh:
ALB多证书ID。取值说明如下：

LoadBalanceType为alb时，使用该字段来配置HTTPS监听多证书，多个证书ID之间使用逗号分割。

ALB使用的SSL证书ID需要从数字证书产品获取。例如配置`756***-cn-hangzhou`，`756***`为产品页获取的证书ID, `-cn-hangzhou`为固定后缀。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209076.html
parameters.name: cert_ids

parameters.help_en:
The default forwarding rule. Traffic is forwarded to the specified application based on the IP address through the specified port. The parameters are as follows:

appId: the ID of the application.
containerPort: the port of the application instance.

All requests that do not match or meet the forwarding rules in Rules are forwarded to the specified application
parameters.help_zh:
默认转发规则。按照IP地址，通过指定端口转发流量到指定应用。参数说明如下：

appId：应用ID。
containerPort：应用实例端口。

所有未匹配或不满足Rules转发规则的请求都会转到该指定应用
parameters.name: default_rule

parameters.help_en:
The forwarding rules. Traffic is forwarded to the specified application based on the domain name and the request path through the specified port. The parameters are as follows:

appId: the ID of the application.
containerPort: the port of the application instance.
domain: the domain name.
path: the URI of the request.
backendProtocol: the backend service Terms of Service. Valid values: http, https, and grpc. Default value: http.
rewritePath: the rewrite path.

Currently, only ALB supports the URL path rewrite (RewritePath) feature. CLB does not support this feature
parameters.help_zh:
转发规则。按照域名和请求路径，通过指定端口转发流量到指定应用。参数说明如下：

appId：应用ID。
containerPort：应用实例端口。
domain：域名。
path：请求路径。
backendProtocol：后端服务协议，支持http/https/grpc，默认值为http。
rewritePath：重写路径。

目前仅有ALB支持设置URL路径重写（RewritePath）功能，CLB不支持此功能
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SLB instance. The type depends on the value specified when the routing rule is created and cannot be changed during updates. Valid values:

clb: Classic Load Balancer (CLB).
alb: Application Load Balancer (ALB)
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡SLB的类型。取决于创建路由规则时填写的类型，更新时不可变更。取值说明如下：

clb：传统型负载均衡CLB（原SLB）。
alb：应用型负载均衡ALB
parameters.name: load_balance_type

parameters.help_en:
The request forwarding protocol. Valid values:

HTTP: applicable to applications that need to identify data content.
HTTPS: applicable to applications that require encrypted transmission
parameters.help_zh:
请求转发协议。取值说明如下：

HTTP：适用于需要对数据内容进行识别的应用。
HTTPS：适用于需要加密传输的应用
parameters.name: listener_protocol

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security policy instance
parameters.help_zh: 安全策略实例 ID
parameters.name: security_policy_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies the request timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 180. If the backend server does not send a response within the timeout period, load balancing stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error code to the client
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：1~180。
如果在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，给客户端返回HTTP 504错误码
parameters.name: request_timeout

parameters.help_en: Specifies the connection idle timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 60. If no access request is received within the timeout period, load balancing temporarily breaks the current connection until a new connection is established when the next request arrives
parameters.help_zh:
指定连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：1~60。
如果在超时时间内一直没有访问请求，负载均衡会暂时中断当前连接，直到一下次请求来临时重新建立新的连接
parameters.name: idle_timeout

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the feature to obtain the client IP address of the visitor through the X-Forwarded-For header field
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启通过X-Forwarded-For头字段获取来访者客户端IP
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to obtain the listening port of the load balancing instance through the X-Forwarded-Port header field
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Port头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听端口
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for_client_src_port

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to obtain the listening protocol of the load balancing instance through the X-Forwarded-Proto header field
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Proto头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听协议
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for_proto

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to obtain the load balancing instance ID through the SLB-ID header field
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过SLB-ID头字段获取负载均衡实例ID
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for_slb_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to obtain the listening port of the load balancing instance through the X-Forwarded-Port header field
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Port头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听端口
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for_slb_port

parameters.help_en:
The address type. Valid values:
Internet: public network address.
Intranet: private network address
parameters.help_zh:
地址类型：
Internet：公网地址。
Intranet：私网地址
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the Application Load Balancer (ALB). Different editions have different feature limits and billing policy. Valid values:

Standard: Standard Edition.

StandardWithWaf: WAF-enhanced Edition
parameters.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

Standard：标准版。

StandardWithWaf：WAF增强版
parameters.name: load_balancer_edition

parameters.help_en:
The JSON string of the zone and vSwitch mapping list. If the current region supports two or more zones, you must add at least two zones. A ZoneMapping structure includes:

VSwitchId: the vSwitch corresponding to the zone. Data type: String. Only one vSwitch and one subnet can be used in each zone.

ZoneId: the zone ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance. Data type: String
parameters.help_zh:
可用区及交换机映射列表的JSON字符串。若当前地域支持 2 个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加 2 个可用区。一个ZoneMapping结构为：

VSwitchId，String类型，可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区只能使用一台交换机和一个子网。

ZoneId，String类型，网络型负载均衡实例的可用区 ID
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en: The cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configuration
parameters.help_zh: 跨域配置
parameters.name: cors_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable data compression
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启数据压缩
parameters.name: enable_gzip

Code.description_en:
The API status code or POP error code. Valid values:

2xx: successful.
3xx: redirected.
4xx: request error.
5xx: server error
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

IngressId.description_en: The ID of the routing rule

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:

If the request is successful, the ErrorCode field is not returned.
If the request fails, the ErrorCode field is returned. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The additional information. Valid values:

If the request is normal, success is returned.
If the request is abnormal, a specific error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the routing rule was created successfully. Valid values:

true: created successfully.
false: failed to create
Success.description_zh:
创建路由规则是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：创建成功。
false：创建失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID, which is used to accurately query the call information
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
